num_facilities: <int> Number of potential facility locations that may be opened.
num_customers: <int> Number of customers that must be served by open facilities.
facility_locations_x: <list[float], length num_facilities> Horizontal coordinate of each potential facility location.
facility_locations_y: <list[float], length num_facilities> Vertical coordinate of each potential facility location.
customer_locations_x: <list[float], length num_customers> Horizontal coordinate of each customer location.
customer_locations_y: <list[float], length num_customers> Vertical coordinate of each customer location.
opening_costs: <list[float], length num_facilities> Cost incurred for opening each facility.
allocation_costs: <list[list[float]], shape [num_facilities][num_customers]> Cost coefficient for serving each customer from each facility.
